title: Short Shelves: Thursday
notes: Outline, stage 2, side quest: "Continues from Monday. [Pastor Ruth] needs one hour on Thursday. It feeds your Purpose choice." Claude's draft. She doesn't preach.
Runs when you walk into the church during the Thursday pantry, or from the Help at the pantry action.

work.speaker: [Pastor Ruth]

text: "You came." She says it like a fact, not a surprise.
She looks up from a box of canned corn. "Well. Grab a box cutter."
The basement smells like cardboard and coffee. Canned corn, peanut butter, a pallet of cereal somebody's church sent over.
She hands you a box cutter and a job, and then she leaves you alone with it. She doesn't preach. She doesn't thank you every five minutes. She just keeps the line moving.
A woman with two kids takes the last jar of peanut butter you shelved. You watch it go.

choices.label: Finish the hour.
result: At the end she says, "Same time next week, if you want it. I won't ask."
choices.record: One hour at the food pantry.

choices.label: "I'll be here."
choices.record: Said I'd be back at the pantry next Thursday.
